title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travel through a wormhole near Saturn to find a new habitable planet for humanity as Earth faces extinction.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is given a chance to erase his criminal past by planting an idea in someone's mind.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A young blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that leads him to search for a former blade runner who has been missing for decades.

title: The Matrix
description: A hacker discovers that reality as he knows it is a simulation controlled by machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist is recruited to communicate with alien lifeforms after mysterious spacecraft land around the world.

title: Her
description: A lonely writer develops a deep emotional relationship with an advanced artificial intelligence operating system.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier caught in a time loop relives the same battle against alien invaders and becomes humanity's key to survival.

title: Ex Machina
description: A programmer is invited to evaluate a humanoid AI but soon realizes the machine may be more intelligent and deceptive than expected.

title: Coherence
description: During a dinner party, a group of friends experience increasingly strange events after a comet passes overhead, leading to reality fractures and alternate versions of themselves.

title: Annihilation
description: A group of scientists enter a mysterious quarantine zone where the laws of nature are being rewritten by an unknown force.

title: Prisoners
description: A father takes matters into his own hands after his daughter and her friend go missing, while a detective investigates the case.

title: Moon
description: An astronaut nearing the end of a lonely three-year shift on the moon base begins to question his reality after discovering a hidden truth.

title: Donnie Darko
description: A troubled teenager experiences visions of a mysterious figure in a rabbit suit who manipulates him into committing strange acts.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier caught in a time loop relives the same battle against alien invaders and gradually becomes humanity’s last hope.

title: Snowpiercer
description: In a frozen post-apocalyptic world, the last survivors of humanity live on a train divided by class warfare.

title: The Prestige
description: Two rival magicians engage in a dangerous obsession to create the ultimate stage illusion, sacrificing everything in the process.
